## Body

At F274 head 12e0017, exact-head macOS clippy and all 27 recovery tests passed. Independent isolated real-SQLite probes established that the first accepted heartbeat clears unheard_since_boot, two serial seats share one boot-relative deadline, and abort/join cancels a pending 60-second sleep without a recovery event or control. Each guard mutant independently failed its intended regression. Keep a fixed boot deadline distinct from end-to-end latency: serial backlog, existing gap throttle and awaited I/O are outside it. The final lease read protects process/composer-read renewals, not renewals after that explicit linearization point; do not hold the native lock across control admission without proving lock order. Optional diagnostic follow-up N328-R1-01 is to log late lease-read errors while preserving fail-closed suppression. MagicWand: encode an isolated exact-head review-proof recipe with canonical shared-build target, guard mutants and named cleanup receipts; shared-lock waits dominated this review, while actual targeted builds were about 35-41 seconds.
